description:
## Problem
The Next.js app in cosmo-clawagent/ has no test harness: package.json defines no "test" script, there is no vitest or jest configuration file, and no *.test.* or *.spec.* files are tracked anywhere in cosmo-clawagent/. As a result, regressions in components or utility code cannot be caught automatically before merge.

Source: repository probe test-harness:missing @ baseline 74d18d1c93bcdfcb9e23459695a0961570f19995 (run run-2026-07-21T16-11-30-862Z)
Baseline: zorgrk-Yommits/cosmo-website @ 74d18d1c93bcdfcb9e23459695a0961570f19995 (branch master)

## Evidence (baseline state)
```
cosmo-clawagent/package.json has no "test" script, no vitest/jest config file exists, and no *.test/*.spec files are tracked in cosmo-clawagent/ — regressions cannot be caught automatically.
```
Evidence sha256: 765e197fb1e207c81292b81c03418b998ac0a6809a1b36fac91b7addc3bb72a9

## Expected result
cosmo-clawagent/ has a working vitest harness: a "test" script in package.json, a vitest config file, and at least 3 passing tests covering existing pure/utility code, so that "npx vitest run" exits 0.

## Allowed scope
- cosmo-clawagent/package.json
- cosmo-clawagent/package-lock.json
- cosmo-clawagent/vitest.config.ts
- cosmo-clawagent/**/*.test.ts
- cosmo-clawagent/**/*.test.tsx
- cosmo-clawagent/tsconfig.json

## Forbidden changes
- Do not modify, rename, or delete any existing source, page, or component files except to add sibling test files
- Do not change the Next.js static-export build configuration or any npm scripts other than adding the "test" script
- Do not attempt to fix the 12 known lint errors tracked in issue #2 or alter lint configuration
- Do not add e2e/browser test frameworks (Playwright, Cypress) or network-dependent tests
- No changes to secrets, key material, .env files, or credentials of any kind
- No changes to contracts, chain code, wallets, or anything on-chain
- No changes to deployment configuration (nginx, PM2, CI/CD, DNS)
- No new runtime dependencies and no major version bumps

## Starting state
git clone https://github.com/zorgrk-Yommits/cosmo-website.git; cd cosmo-website; git checkout 74d18d1c93bcdfcb9e23459695a0961570f19995; cd cosmo-clawagent; npm ci (Node 22)

## Work steps
1. Add vitest (and @vitest/coverage if desired) as devDependencies in cosmo-clawagent/package.json via npm install --save-dev
2. Create cosmo-clawagent/vitest.config.ts configured for the project's TypeScript setup
3. Add a "test" script running "vitest run" to cosmo-clawagent/package.json
4. Identify pure functions or utility modules in the existing code that can be tested without a browser or network
5. Write at least 3 unit tests in *.test.ts(x) files asserting current behavior of that code
6. Run npx vitest run and confirm all tests pass with exit code 0
7. Run npm run build and confirm the static-export build still exits 0

## Deliverables
- Pull request against master

Risk class: low

## Abort & escalation
1. Deadline passes without a passed verification: the job lapses, no payment is made, escrow is reclaimed.
2. Verification fails: exactly one revision round within the deadline, then the job is aborted.
3. Any dispute: manual operator review decides; there is no automatic payout.
4. The provider works only on an own branch/fork of the baseline: no merge rights, no deployment, no secrets; any adoption of the work requires explicit human approval.
5. A buyer-side HALT signal stops all further COSMO actions on this job, including settlement.

## Why this job suits an external agent
Bootstrapping a vitest harness with a few unit tests over existing pure code is self-contained, needs no secrets, deploy access, or on-chain interaction, and success is fully machine-checkable via exit codes of npx vitest run and npm run build at a pinned baseline commit.
